findings.description: The bucket has no server-side encryption configuration, so objects such as customer-master.xlsx are not guaranteed to be encrypted at rest with a customer-controlled or explicitly configured S3 encryption setting.
The financials bucket has no server-side encryption configuration, leaving stored financial data without an explicitly enforced encryption-at-rest control.
The operations bucket has no server-side encryption configuration, so encryption at rest is not explicitly enforced for its contents.
The data_science bucket has no server-side encryption configuration, so encryption at rest is not explicitly enforced for data stored in the bucket.
